source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Go to the appliance.
3. Apply a test tag.
4. Do the test.
5. Get the result.
6. Apply a pass, warning or fail tag.
7. Enter details in the appliance test records.
8. Use the most accurate method available.
9. Measure lead resistance.
10. Using the most accurate method available, test the insulation resistance.
11. Use the next most accurate method available, test the earth continuity.
12. Perform tests on every cord.
13. Keep the test leads disconnected from power.
14. First set up the test equipment.
15. Then connect it to the appliance, or the building.
16. Include the extension cord.
17. Include a power point from the building.
18. Then re-perform the tests.
19. If the result hasn't changed much
